notes: Five test passes against the installed build. The big one: a single lap missing 14 position samples out of 1001 was destroying the whole session's centreline, and with it every racing-line comparison GOAT makes - Corner Debrief said “No position data available to compare your line here” for all sixteen corners of a session whose position data was complete, while the map drew both lines above the message. It now reads “You ran 2.8m wider through here than your reference.” Corner Debrief's stat cards were cutting off their own values (the best lap read “1:53...”); the corner tree was clipped with no way to scroll to eight of sixteen corners; the lap table collapsed to five rows. The Spanish headline was half-translated, and longer Spanish headers were pushing the last lap-table column off the end. Launching GOAT while it was already running started a second server on the phone-dashboard port. 807 tests pass.
